newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis edges higher.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis edges higher.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers were mostly firmer on Tuesday while soybean and wheat levels remained largely steady, export sources said.
Corn was boosted by interest from exporters in covering their requirements.
"Exporters are short and they need to buy," one dealer said.
Sources also noted the expected pickup in corn supplies following the opening of the Mississippi River this spring had never fully materialized.
